7.3.1 Event priority
Event priority is defined as a ranking of events based upon level of importance. It is
used to determine which fault entries may be removed from the event memory in
case the number of stored events exceeds the maximum number of memory entries
(event memory is full).
[SWS_Dem_00382] ⌈Each supported event shall have a priority assigned to it (re-
fer to parameter DemDTCPriority in DemDTCAttributes).⌋(RS_Diag_04118, RS_-
Diag_04071)
[SWS_Dem_00383] ⌈A priority value of 1 shall be the highest priority. Larger priority
value shall define lower importance.⌋(RS_Diag_04118, RS_Diag_04071)
